rationale: Immune susceptibility and synovial fibroblast disease biology; not fibroblast-specific inherited risk.
Cardiac electrophysiology; interpretation depends on atrial versus ventricular identity. European-ancestry meta-analysis; replaces Roselli 2025, which has no GWAS Catalog summary statistics.

Colorectal epithelial neoplasia; mature colonocytes are a lineage proxy, not a proven exclusive initiating cell. Million Veteran Program, European ancestry; replaces Law 2019, which has no GWAS Catalog summary statistics; few credible sets.
Atherosclerosis implicates vascular and immune cells; extensive SuSiE-inf coverage.
Vascular tone and pressure; pericytes are a broader mural-cell proxy and renal mechanisms also contribute.
Complementary blood-pressure phenotype; not independent of systolic BP.
Fibroproliferative disease with myofibroblast biology; tissue-specific comparator.
Hepatic lipoprotein metabolism; additional tissues contribute.
Complementary lipid transport phenotype; correlated with other lipid traits.
Hepatic triglyceride and lipoprotein metabolism; additional tissues contribute.
Liver enzyme phenotype related to hepatocyte function and injury. Pan-UK Biobank, European ancestry; replaces Ghouse 2024, which has no GWAS Catalog summary statistics.

Strong beta-cell evidence with alpha-cell regulatory involvement; not alpha-specific and includes systemic insulin resistance. Million Veteran Program, European ancestry, the largest European T2D GWAS with GWAS Catalog summary statistics; replaces Suzuki 2024, which has none.

Non-fasting glucose; beta-cell and hepatic glucose regulation, with insulin action in other tissues. European-ancestry meta-analysis, the largest European glucose GWAS with GWAS Catalog summary statistics; replaces fasting glucose (Jee 2025), which has none.
